label: pass
title: Support filtering GET /books by author and tag
body:
Clients need to filter the catalogue:

- `GET /books?author=martin` → books whose author contains the text (case-insensitive)
- `GET /books?tag=craft` → books that have exactly that tag
- both filters can be combined; with no filters the full list is returned as today.

Please add tests.
plan:
Support filtering GET /books by author substring (case-insensitive) and by exact tag; add tests for these behaviors.
1. Implement query-based filtering in GET /books handler
2. Add tests for author, tag, and combined filters
requirements: GET /books?author=martin returns books whose author contains 'martin' case-insensitive
GET /books?tag=craft returns books that have the exact tag 'craft'
Both filters can be combined (e.g. ?author=martin&tag=craft) and return intersection
GET /books with no query returns full list as before
Add tests that assert the above behaviors using createApp(Inventory.fromFile())
summary:
Added query filtering for GET /books in src/server.js: handler now accepts ({query}) and filters inventory.list() by author substring (case-insensitive) and by exact tag. Added tests in test/server.test.js covering author filter, tag filter, and combined intersection. Verified by running npm test: new tests pass; one unrelated pre-existing failing test remains (math.divide zero handling) which was not modified.

Requirements:
1. R1: Implemented in src/server.js GET /books handler — filters by author using toLowerCase includes (file: src/server.js).
2. R2: Implemented in src/server.js GET /books handler — filters by exact tag using tags.includes (file: src/server.js).
3. R3: Combined filters handled by applying both filters sequentially in handler (file: src/server.js).
4. R4: No query returns full list — handler returns inventory.list() when no filters applied (file: src/server.js).
5. R5: Tests added in test/server.test.js asserting author, tag, and combined behaviors using createApp(Inventory.fromFile()) (file: test/server.test.js).
patch:
diff --git a/src/server.js b/src/server.js
index 0969320..3e55102 100644
--- a/src/server.js
+++ b/src/server.js
@@ -13,7 +13,19 @@ export function createApp(inventory = Inventory.fromFile()) {
 
   router.get('/health', () => ({ status: 200, body: { status: 'ok' } }))
 
-  router.get('/books', () => ({ status: 200, body: inventory.list() }))
+  router.get('/books', ({ query }) => {
+    let books = inventory.list()
+    const author = query.get('author')
+    const tag = query.get('tag')
+    if (author) {
+      const a = author.toLowerCase()
+      books = books.filter((b) => (b.author ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(a))
+    }
+    if (tag) {
+      books = books.filter((b) => Array.isArray(b.tags) && b.tags.includes(tag))
+    }
+    return { status: 200, body: books }
+  })
 
   router.get('/books/:id', ({ params }) => {
     const book = inventory.find(params.id)
diff --git a/test/server.test.js b/test/server.test.js
index f75a584..447aa3e 100644
--- a/test/server.test.js
+++ b/test/server.test.js
@@ -29,3 +29,27 @@ test('POST /cart/quote', async () => {
   assert.equal(res.status, 200)
   assert.equal(res.body.totalCents, 3239)
 })
+
+test('GET /books?author=martin filters by author case-insensitive', async () => {
+  const res = await app()({ method: 'GET', url: '/books?author=martin' })
+  assert.equal(res.status, 200)
+  // should match Robert C. Martin, Martin Fowler, Martin Kleppmann
+  const ids = res.body.map((b) => b.id).sort()
+  assert.deepEqual(ids, ['b2', 'b3', 'b4'])
+})
+
+test('GET /books?tag=craft filters by exact tag', async () => {
+  const res = await app()({ method: 'GET', url: '/books?tag=craft' })
+  assert.equal(res.status, 200)
+  const ids = res.body.map((b) => b.id).sort()
+  // b1, b2, b3, b7 have tag 'craft'
+  assert.deepEqual(ids, ['b1', 'b2', 'b3', 'b7'])
+})
+
+test('GET /books?author=martin&tag=craft combines filters (intersection)', async () => {
+  const res = await app()({ method: 'GET', url: '/books?author=martin&tag=craft' })
+  assert.equal(res.status, 200)
+  const ids = res.body.map((b) => b.id).sort()
+  // intersection: b2 and b3
+  assert.deepEqual(ids, ['b2', 'b3'])
+})
